title: Vimag Labs starts production at Haryana plant, plans ₹50 crore investment
description:
Accel-backed deep-tech startup Vimag Labs on Tuesday said it has started production at its first manufacturing facility at Jhajjar, in Haryana and plans to invest Rs 50 crore in a phased manner in scaling capacity.
Vimag, which manufactures and assembles motor and control systems and related propulsion systems, has already completed and exported its first production batch from the Jhajjar facility, the company said.
The site is the starting point of a phased manufacturing build-out in India, the company said, adding it currently plans around Rs 50 crore investment across this build-out.
"Our initial focus is on scaling mid-power motor and control systems for commercial programmes. As customer programmes mature, we plan to extend manufacturing into high-power systems of 570 kW and above and deepen partnerships across India for manufacturing, supply chain, tooling and industrialisation," said Manish Seth, Co-founder and CEO, Vimag Labs.
